items.headline: Frost Advisory issued November 14 at 1:46PM EST until November 15 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 34 will result in frost formation,
especially inland of the beaches.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Coastal Brunswick, Coastal New Hanover,
Coastal Pender, and Inland New Hanover Counties. In South Carolina,
Coastal Georgetown and Coastal Horry Counties.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
